recognize_zh: 高倍下大型細胞沿著斜走的竇狀血管內成排排列，核卵圓至凹陷、染色質泡狀、一至數個明顯核仁、細胞質淡染，周圍是較小的造血細胞；腫瘤細胞侷限於血管腔內是診斷血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的重點。
features: Large atypical cells aligned within a diagonally oriented sinusoid
Oval to indented/cleaved nuclei with vesicular chromatin and one to several prominent nucleoli
Moderate pale to amphophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell membranes
Surrounding smaller hematopoietic cells (erythroid precursors, granulocytes) outside the vascular lumen
No sheet-like or mass-forming extravascular infiltrate
describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows large atypical lymphoid cells confined within a sinusoidal lumen, arranged in a linear cluster. The cells have oval to indented nuclei with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm, and are two to three times the size of the surrounding hematopoietic cells. Adjacent marrow shows residual erythroid and myeloid elements without an extravascular mass. The intrasinusoidal distribution of large atypical cells is consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma, to be confirmed by CD20 and CD31/CD34 immunostains.

ddx.vs: Conventional DLBCL forms interstitial or nodular extravascular aggregates rather than being confined to sinusoidal lumina.
Sinusoidal but composed of monotonous medium-sized cells with less prominent nucleoli and a CD3+ CD4- CD8- T-cell phenotype.
Megakaryocytes have multilobated nuclei with abundant pink cytoplasm and are extravascular, while proerythroblasts form interstitial islands rather than intraluminal strings.
Carcinoma emboli are cohesive and keratin positive, not CD20 positive.
